en-US.name: GIF Factory
en-US.summary: GIF factory skill for stickers, lenticular cards, motion posters and related styles, plus five companion skills. MIT license is present, but this snapshot stays listing-only: the pin contains hundreds of files over 1 MiB (about 676 MiB), including assets inside skills/, so a full git install exceeds the ordinary audit budget.
en-US.description: Pinned at e89003a4a6ca4fd0e9e39c8859851b58c82bc368. Root LICENSE is MIT. The tree has a root SKILL.md plus five skills/* companions and 245 files over 1 MiB (about 676 MiB), including 179 under skills/. excludePaths would only skip automatic audit traversal and would not stop a git installer from fetching those files. No slim local package was admitted in this change.
